english.synthetic: Written for tests. No real person.

segments.text: Good day, Mrs. Dumitrescu. I called you to discuss Vlad's math grades.
Good day. I know he got a 4 on the last test.
Yes, and he missed three times this month. I propose recovery classes on Tuesday, after school.
That's fine. I'll make sure he comes to all classes.
I prepare an exercise sheet on fractions until Monday.
May I write to you by email if he has questions?
Sure. And please sign the grade book by Friday.
The recovery test will be on November 25th.
